form.title: Computation of Section 737 Gain

lines.caption: Enter the FMV of the distributed property (other than money)
Enter your adjusted basis in the partnership immediately before the distribution. See Basis Limitations, earlier
Enter the amount of money received in the distribution
Subtract line 3 from line 2. If zero or less, enter -0-
Section 737 gain. Enter the lesser of the amount reported on line 5 or line 6

form.notes: A WORKSHEET in the Partner's Instructions for Schedule K-1 (Form 1065), box 19 code B. Its inputs come from the partnership's attached statement (FMV of the distributed property, money received, net precontribution gain) and the partner's own basis. Line 7 is reported on Form 4797 or Form 8949 and Schedule D by the character the contributed property would have had.
